paper_relationship.Gramfort_2013: Adaptation of section 3.3, Figure 8 and Table 3; not its left-only per-time SVC/ShuffleSplit numerical result.
paper_relationship.King_Dehaene_2014: Held-out-trial temporal-decoding motivation; pooled-time LR is not a temporal-generalization matrix.

source.channels: all source gradiometers in original order, excluding source bads
source.decim_reason: Keep released 40-Hz low-pass signal at native 150.15374755859375-Hz sampling; decim2 has inadequate Nyquist.

epochs.other_events: record in source ledger as not_target; never classifier rows
epochs.offset_rule: integer round(tmin*sfreq)..round(tmax*sfreq), both endpoints included; subtract raw.first_samp to index raw
epochs.baseline: per-epoch per-sensor mean over offsets <=0, including offset0, subtracted from all epoch values
epochs.projection: source SSP restricted to selected gradiometers; verify identity here because all supplied vectors are mag/EEG-only; do not fit new projectors
epochs.reject_rule: reject any selected sensor PTP strictly greater than limit over all 106 full-rate samples; equality retained
epochs.failure: nonfinite selected signal, unexpected relevant source projection/annotation or invalid source identity is failed_precondition, not an invented clean epoch
epochs.trial_id: zero-based retained chronological target-event position; preserve source_event_index and absolute event sample
epochs.analysis_time_rule: select exact integer offsets/sfreq inclusively inside analysis_window; no rounded linspace

folds.reuse: identical trial-to-fold assignment for pooled and every per_time model
folds.feasibility: each class at least five retained trials; both classes in every training fold

estimators.pooled: one model per fold trained on all analysis-time rows of training trials, trial-major time-minor order; predict every time of held-out trials
estimators.per_time: one separate model per fold and time trained on training trials at that time only
estimators.scaler: training observations only, per-feature arithmetic mean and population standard deviation (ddof0); constant/numerically constant StandardScaler features use scale1
estimators.equivalent_solvers: allowed when converged to same public objective within score tolerances
estimators.optimization_gate: finite coefficients and scores; no convergence warning; infinity norm of gradient of objective/n_train <=1e-9; record all warnings and actual iterations rather than suppress them

aggregation.headline: unweighted arithmetic mean of five pooled-model fold accuracies
aggregation.pooled_oof_accuracy: total correct pooled-model rows divided by all held-out trial-time rows, separately named
aggregation.timecourse_accuracy: at each time, unweighted mean of five per_time-model fold accuracies
aggregation.timecourse_pooled_accuracy: at each time, all per_time-model OOF correct trials divided by retained trials
aggregation.no_outcome_gate: no required above-chance score, nonconstant curve/folds, expected gap/sign, ranking or prose keyword

outputs.source_ledger_nulls: blank modality for non-target, blank trial_id for non-retained; blank PTP/channel for non-target or unavailable epoch; retained is0/1
outputs.per_fold_semantics: class counts are trials; time_index blank for pooled, integer for per_time; key estimator,time_index,fold
outputs.decoding_results.json: status=ok, accuracy, pooled_oof_accuracy, n_trials, n_time_samples_per_trial, n_samples_total, n_classes=2, n_channels, n_folds=5, classes, chance_level=0.5
outputs.run_metadata.json: status=ok, source_manifest_sha256, method_contract_sha256, complete source_metadata and support_metadata, nonempty software_versions, fitting_diagnostics; scientific source fields checked, actual version strings/iteration counts not secretly matched
outputs.findings.md: nonempty actual measured summary with within-recording/one-person and estimator limitations; no keyword grading
outputs.private_authoring_receipts: all source epoch features, retained source-event IDs, folds, scaler means/scales, coefficients/intercepts, full signed scores, gradients and warning diagnostics; excluded from participant image

numeric_tolerances.classification_near_zero: submitted class must follow its own signed score; a numerically equivalent near-zero score can change a label within score tolerance; summaries must recompute from submitted labels

metadata_fields.offset_fields: complete integer offset arrays, not just endpoints
metadata_fields.event_code_counts: JSON objects keyed by original integer code written as string; include all original codes for source and1/2/3/4 including zeros for retained
metadata_fields.overlap_pairs: count adjacent chronological target pairs with any inclusive raw sample overlap in the indicated windows; source samples rather than nominal stimulus intervals
metadata_fields.fit_requirement: n_models=5+5*n_times, all_converged=true, finite nonnegative max_mean_gradient_inf<=1e-9; warnings list preserved, convergence warnings mean failure; exact iteration counts not required
metadata_fields.software_versions: nonempty object of honest nonempty version strings; not identical-to-oracle gate

scope_limits: One person and one recording; trials/time rows/sensors/folds are not independent people.

Whole-trial grouping prevents same-trial row overlap, not all temporal dependence or source-level preprocessing reuse. Source event metadata has 149 overlapping adjacent candidate epochs and 71 prior-analysis/next-baseline overlaps; no posthoc exclusions or universal leakage-free claim.
No claim of new-person/new-session/unseen-latency generalization, cognitive onset, hardware evaluation or paper numerical reproduction.
Source license does not establish unrestricted data/image redistribution; local method-control use only.
Oracle/source checks do not establish model difficulty; public answers remain contamination risks.
reward: all-or-nothing; every required scientific/schema check must pass; no proportional-credit promise
